caption: The drawing depicts a standing male figure, appearing to be a statue or figurine, positioned on a rectangular wooden base. The figure is dressed formally with black shoes, black trousers, a white shirt, a green waistcoat, a black jacket with tails, and a black bow tie. The exposed parts of the figure, such as the head and hands, are brown in color. The right arm hangs straight down, while the left hand is bent towards the chest. The background is a plain, light beige color with some visible spots or marks. There is a signature and date near the bottom left corner of the image close to the base.
title: Hotel Porter Figure
